objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document in DHC VISION for policies, guidelines and documents, including content, metadata, versions, release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Corresponding type selected when creating a new document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document and used for workflow status.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment for reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Personal authorization attribute for the document author.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Attribute for additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Personal authorization attribute for reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Personal authorization attribute for releasers, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date used to calculate validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which a validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are kept before physical deletion.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects workflow task distribution when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

attributes.name: criticality
attributes.description: Lack of criticality is stated as reason it can be directly deleted.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to assign read and change rights to users/persons.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user of the DHC VISION system.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned authorizations or distribution for documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for system roles, reader assignment, distribution and authorizations.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role implemented in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: document_reader
objs.description: System role for readers that can view approved objects.

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: System role for users offered in author or co-author selection lists and able to create document types and change proposals.

objs.name: document_checker
objs.description: System role for reviewers who check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: document_approver
objs.description: System role for releasers responsible for the document and its content.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: System role for translating released content into another language.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting the content or version history of the document.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing Change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created for invalidating a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for revalidating invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested from persons and users of assigned user groups.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled using distribution groups.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document visible in corresponding login language after release.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.
